lead.question: 一个七岁的女孩，凭什么成了画家眼中最好的艺术评论家？
lead.warmup: 学艺术的学生画画不少，却常被“懂行”的人围着点评——其实他们并不懂，只是装懂，张口就告诉你一幅画“意思”是什么。作者不以为然：许多画根本没有“意思”，不过是好看的图案，喜欢它们就像喜欢漂亮的窗帘布。真正让他服气的是七岁的妹妹：她不装，看得细，一眼就看出新画挂倒了。
goals: 复述课文：说清“装懂的大人”与“七岁妹妹”两次点评的对比和结尾的反转
掌握 art、critic、paint、pretend、pattern、curtain material、appreciate、notice、hang 等本课词汇
学会 in the same way that/as、whether...or not、better than anyone else、for a moment、upside down 等句型
巩固一般现在时（普遍情况、习惯动作、三单 -s），并区分 many、much、many a
lead.summary: 全文先议后叙。开头 I am an art student 定下身份，paint a lot of pictures 带出话题；接着 many people pretend 一针见血，of course 一转给出理由——许多画本无“意思”，只是 pretty patterns，再拿 curtain material 作比，调侃味十足。后半用 yesterday 转入叙事：七岁的妹妹 critically 看了一会儿，一句 isn't it upside down 戳破作者的自信。
lead.tips: 易错：hang 作“悬挂”时过去式、过去分词是 hung，hanged 意为“绞死”；pretend 只接 to do，不接 doing。

questions.q: Who is the student's best critic?
questions.zh: 这位学艺术的学生最好的评论家是谁？
questions.a: His seven-year-old sister. She is only seven, but she always tells him whether his pictures are good or not — and she was right when she said his new picture was upside down.
questions.aZh: 是他七岁的妹妹。她虽然只有七岁，却总能说出他的画是好是坏，还一眼看出那幅新画挂倒了。
questions.hint: 见 My sister is only seven, but she always tells me whether my pictures are good or not，以及结尾 She was right! It was!

questions.q: Why does the writer say that many people only pretend to understand modern art?
questions.zh: 为什么作者说许多人只是装作懂现代艺术？
questions.a: Because they always tell you what a picture is 'about', while in fact many pictures are not 'about' anything — they are just pretty patterns.
questions.aZh: 因为他们总爱告诉你一幅画“意思”是什么，可事实上许多画根本没有什么“意思”，只是些好看的图案。
questions.hint: 见 Many people pretend that they understand modern art。

questions.q: What comparison does the writer make with pretty curtain material?
questions.zh: 作者拿漂亮的窗帘布作了怎样的比较？
questions.a: He says we like those pictures in the same way that we like pretty curtain material — we enjoy the pretty pattern itself, not any 'meaning' behind it.
questions.aZh: 他说我们喜欢这些画，就像喜欢漂亮的窗帘布一样——喜欢的是好看的图案本身，而不是什么“意思”。
questions.hint: 见 We like them in the same way that we like pretty curtain material。

questions.q: What happened when his sister came into his room yesterday?
questions.zh: 昨天妹妹走进他房间时发生了什么？
questions.a: He was hanging a new picture on the wall and asked if she liked it. She looked at it critically for a moment, said it was all right, and asked whether it was upside down. He looked again — she was right.
questions.aZh: 他正把一幅新画挂到墙上，问妹妹喜不喜欢。她挑剔地看了一会儿，说“还不错”，接着问是不是挂倒了。他再看一眼——她说对了。
questions.hint: 见 I'm hanging this picture on the wall. 与 She looked at it critically for a moment。

questions.q: Why does the writer think young children appreciate modern pictures better than anyone else? What is he satirising?
questions.zh: 为什么作者认为小孩子比任何人都更能欣赏现代绘画？他在讽刺什么？
questions.a: Because children do not pretend: they notice more and judge only what they actually see, while adults keep reciting what a picture is 'about'. He is satirising grown-up critics who fake understanding instead of really looking at the picture.
questions.aZh: 因为孩子不装懂：他们看得更细，凭眼睛说话，而大人只会背“意思”。作者讽刺的正是那些装作内行、却不肯真正看画的评论者。
questions.hint: 联系 I think that young children often appreciate modern pictures better than anyone else. They notice more。

exercises.q: 汉译英：我是个学艺术的学生，画很多画。我最好的评论家是我七岁的妹妹。
exercises.a: I am an art student and I paint a lot of pictures. My best critic is my sister, who is only seven.
exercises.note: art student 艺术系学生；paint 用颜料画。

exercises.q: 填空：Many people pretend ______ (understand) modern art, but in fact they understand nothing.
exercises.note: pretend 后接 to do，不接 doing。

exercises.q: 句型转换：用 as 改写 We like them in the same way that we like pretty curtain material.
exercises.a: We like them in the same way as we like pretty curtain material.
exercises.note: in the same way that/as 可互换。

exercises.q: 改错：Young children are appreciating modern pictures better than anyone else, because they are noticing more.
exercises.a: Young children appreciate modern pictures better than anyone else, because they notice more.
exercises.note: appreciate/notice 表状态，不用进行时。

exercises.q: 汉译英：我正在把这幅画挂到墙上。她挑剔地看了一会儿，说：“还不错，不过是不是挂倒了？”
exercises.a: I'm hanging this picture on the wall. She looked at it critically for a moment. 'It's all right,' she said, 'but isn't it upside down?'
exercises.note: hang 现在分词 hanging；upside down 上下颠倒。

exercises.q: 句型转换：用 whether...or not 改写 She always tells me if my pictures are good or not.
exercises.a: She always tells me whether my pictures are good or not.
exercises.note: whether...or not 比 if 正式。

exercises.q: 填空：My sister always ______ (tell) me whether my pictures are good or not. There isn't ______ (many/much) meaning in these patterns. Many ______ picture ______ (be) just a pretty pattern.
exercises.note: 三单 tells；much+不可数；many a 谓语用单数。

quiz.q: “我是个学艺术的学生，画了很多画。”正确的英文是？
options: I am an art student and I paint a lot of pictures.
I am an art student and I paints a lot of pictures.
I am a art student and I paint a lot of pictures.
I am art student and I paint a lot pictures.
quiz.note: an art student；一般现在时三单加 -s。

quiz.q: “很多人装作懂现代艺术。”下列哪句正确？
options: Many people pretend understanding modern art.
Many people pretend that they understand modern art.
Many people pretend to understanding modern art.
Many people pretend that they understood modern art.
quiz.note: pretend 后接 to do 或 that 从句。

quiz.q: “我们喜爱它们就像喜爱漂亮的窗帘布一样。”课文原句是？
options: We like them in the same way which we like pretty curtain material.
We like them in the same way what we like pretty curtain material.
We like them in the same way that we like pretty curtain material.
We like them on the same way that we like pretty curtain material.
quiz.note: in the same way that/as 为固定比较短语。

quiz.q: “小孩子往往比任何人都更能欣赏现代绘画。”下列哪句正确？
options: Young children often appreciate modern pictures better than anyone.
Young children often are appreciating modern pictures better than anyone else.
Young children often appreciate modern pictures better than anyone other.
Young children often appreciate modern pictures better than anyone else.
quiz.note: anyone else 排除自身；appreciate 不用进行时。

quiz.q: “她总能说出我的画是好还是坏。”下列哪句正确？
options: She always tells me whether my pictures are good or not.
She always tells me that my pictures are good or not.
She always tells me whether are my pictures good or not.
She always tells me whether my pictures good or not.

quiz.q: “你把这幅画挂倒了。”正确的英文是？
options: You've hanged the picture upside down.
You've hung the picture upside down.
You've hung the picture up and down.
You've hung the picture downside up.
quiz.note: hang 悬挂为 hung；hanged 意为绞死。
